title: Equivariant commutative algebras over an affine Hopf action
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $H$ a commutative Hopf $k$-algebra, $E$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $\rho_E:E\to E\otimes_kH$ an algebra coaction in the sense of [def-sfb-hopf-action-module-data]. Define the category of equivariant commutative $E$-algebras: an object is a commutative $k$-algebra $B$, a $k$-algebra homomorphism $j:E\to B$, and an algebra coaction $\rho_B:B\to B\otimes_kH$ such that $\rho_Bj=(j\otimes1)\rho_E$. Its morphisms are $k$-algebra homomorphisms commuting with $j$ and with the coactions. Identity and composition are those of algebra homomorphisms. The invariant subring of $B$ is the equalizer $\{b\in B:\rho_B(b)=b\otimes1\}$. Neither $E$ nor $B$ is required to be finitely generated.
